description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTML' within the Opencart admin extension module, handling management (viewing, saving, adding, deleting) of a custom HTML module in Opencart's admin panel. It includes methods for rendering the module configuration page and performing CRUD operations on the module.

classes.name: Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension\Opencart\Module\HTML
classes.description: Controller class for managing a custom HTML module in Opencart's admin panel, handling rendering and CRUD operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the module configuration page with breadcrumbs, language strings, and module data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module configuration via POST request, validating permissions and input, and responding with JSON.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new HTML module instance, returning success or error in JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified module instance, returning success or error in JSON.
